description: Defines a 'quantizer' class for quantizing floating point numbers to fixed point representation and vice versa, including support for sequences and complex values.

classes.name: quantizer
classes.description: Class for quantizing floating point numbers in range [-1, +1] to fixed point representation and converting back.

methods.name: to_fixed_point
methods.description: Quantizes a floating point or brain float value into a 16-bit integer.

methods.name: to_float
methods.description: Converts a fixed point 16-bit integer back to floating point.

methods.name: to_fixed_point (sequence)
methods.description: Quantizes a sequence of floating point or brain float values into 16-bit integers.

methods.name: to_float (sequence)
methods.description: Converts a sequence of fixed point values to complex floating point values.

methods.name: to_brain_float
methods.description: Converts a sequence of fixed point values to complex brain floating point values.

methods.name: sign_extend
methods.description: Performs sign extension on a 16-bit integer value.
